label: Lock
depicts: Rounded padlock body with a closed shackle above a keyhole
use_when: Use when a screen shows content or actions that are locked behind security or access control.
avoid_when: Do not use for general privacy policy text when the visible meaning is a locked or protected state.

label: Notifications Off
depicts: Bell outline with a diagonal slash crossing from upper left to lower right
use_when: Use when alerts or notifications are muted disabled or intentionally turned off in the current surface.
avoid_when: Do not use for silent audio or generic disable actions when the visible object is specifically a bell.

label: Add User
depicts: Front facing person bust with a small plus sign at upper right
use_when: Use when the interface adds invites or creates a user profile account or member entry.
avoid_when: Do not use for follow social friend actions when the visible cue is a generic person plus control.

label: Add User
depicts: Side profile person bust with a small plus sign at upper right
use_when: Use when the interface adds or invites a person and the profile style matches a side facing user variant.
avoid_when: Do not use interchangeably with the front facing user add icon when variant consistency matters in the product.

label: Remove User
depicts: Side profile person bust with a small x mark at lower right
use_when: Use when the interface removes blocks or dismisses a user profile account or member entry.
avoid_when: Do not use for a generic close action when the visible form is a person symbol with an x badge.
